midtown-lite-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Slim outside, organised inside. The Midtown Lite is cut from soft black sheep leather — one of the gentlest hides we work with — and closes with a single snap button that keeps everything exactly where you left it.

Open it and the layout does the talking: nine card slots, two ID windows with their own snap buttons, two bill slots, and a snap pocket on the outside for the small stuff.

  • Soft, supple sheep leather — lightweight in the pocket
  • 9 card slots + 2 snap-button ID windows
  • 2 bill slots for folded notes
  • Outer snap pocket for small essentials
  • Secure snap-button closure

At PKR 1,499, it's the easiest way into a handcrafted Kordovan wallet — made in Pakistan, and backed by the same lifetime craftsmanship warranty as everything we build.

nappa-leather-bifold-wallet-for-men-dark.descriptionHtml:
Every wardrobe needs one wallet that simply works. The Plain Bifold is Kordovan's classic — soft genuine nappa leather folded once, the horse-head mark embossed quietly on the front, and nothing else to announce it.

Inside, the layout you already know by heart: six card slots, an ID window, and a full-width compartment for banknotes. Thin, light and deliberately compact — designed to pack tight without growing thick.

  • 100% genuine nappa leather — soft from day one
  • Bifold design — 6 card slots, ID window, interior cash slot
  • KORDOVAN embossed front
  • Topstitching and seaming details
  • Slim, contemporary profile

Tan is the warm, everyday choice that deepens with handling; Black is the formal one. Both are cut and stitched by hand in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty.

No gimmicks, no mechanisms — just the bifold, done properly.

shelby-thomas-soft-milled-leather-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Some wallets take months to feel like yours. The Shelby & Thomas starts there. Cut from soft milled genuine cow leather, this bifold has a flexible, broken-in feel from the very first day — the easy-going cousin to Kordovan's firmer full-grain wallets.

  • 100% genuine soft milled cow leather
  • Bifold design — 12 card slots
  • Flap ID window
  • 2 internal cash slots
  • Topstitching and seaming detail

Two shades, one soft hide: Shelby and Thomas — pick the tone that suits your everyday. Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty.

the-aristocrat-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Not every wallet needs to shout. The Aristocrat is the quiet one — a slim, classic-cut genuine leather wallet with clean lines and understated styling, for those who prefer restraint over rugged texture.

  • Premium genuine leather construction
  • Multiple compartments for cards and cash
  • Slim, streamlined profile
  • Equally at home in a suit pocket or a weekend jacket

Brown for warmth, Black for the boardroom. Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — understated styling, built to last.

tp-the-corporate-laptop-bag.descriptionHtml:
The Corporate – Where Business Meets Elegance
A refined statement for the modern professional, The Corporate is more than just a laptop bag—it’s an extension of your ambition. Handcrafted from premium full-grain leather, this sleek and structured briefcase exudes confidence and class, making it the perfect companion for boardroom meetings, business travels, and everyday executive life.
Features:
✅ Timeless Craftsmanship: Made from high-quality leather, ensuring durability and an effortlessly sophisticated look.✅ Smart Organization: Thoughtfully designed compartments for your laptop, documents, and essentials, including pen holders and a dedicated phone pocket.✅ Versatile Carrying: Dual carry handles and an adjustable, padded shoulder strap for comfort and style on the move.✅ Secure & Functional: A sturdy zippered closure and an external pocket for quick-access items keep you prepared for any professional setting.
Whether you’re sealing deals, leading teams, or making your mark, The Corporate ensures you do it in style.
🚀 For those who mean business.

rigor-wallet-lite.descriptionHtml:
Ten cards. Two bill compartments. Still slim. The Rigor Lite is built for organised minimalists who refuse to choose between capacity and profile — soft genuine sheep leather keeps it light while the layout takes everything a working day demands.

  • 100% genuine sheep leather — supple and lightweight
  • 10 card slots — the full deck, each in its place
  • 2 bill compartments for folded notes
  • Slim, flat profile that disappears into a pocket

Brown for warmth, Black for the formal week. At PKR 1,499, it's proof that handcrafted doesn't need to mean expensive — made in Pakistan, backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty.

the-bastion-handcrafted-genuine-leather-.descriptionHtml:
Built for men who value durability, structure and timeless design. The Bastion is a classic bifold handcrafted from premium genuine cow leather — rugged character and everyday practicality in equal measure, with a naturally distressed finish that deepens into a rich patina and makes every wallet uniquely yours.

The interior keeps your essentials organised without adding bulk: a transparent ID window for quick access, dedicated card slots, and a smooth leather cash-fold compartment. The slim profile sits easily in a pocket — an ideal everyday carry.

  • Premium genuine cow leather with a distressed patina finish
  • Bifold design — transparent ID window
  • Card slots + leather cash-fold compartment
  • Slim, structured profile

Available in Tan and Brown. Not a trend-driven accessory — a long-term companion built to age beautifully, handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty.
